dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちわ、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、始めさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but would it be all right if we got started?

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。では、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Let's get started then.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談ですか？話しやすいところからお話しくださいね。
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today? Please feel free to start wherever you're comfortable.

dialogue.content: 職場の人間関係で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with relationships at work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し具体的にお話しいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me about it in a little more detail?

dialogue.content: 正職員として六人の中で一番新米ではあるんですが、
dialogue.English: I’m the newest among the six full-time staff members, but…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 現場で働く上で、上から三番目に位置を置かれているんですが
dialogue.English: But in terms of my position on the floor, I'm ranked third from the top.

dialogue.content: 役職の名前が私だけ無くて、
dialogue.English: But I'm the only one who doesn't have a job title.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: それは、何とも思ってないんですが
dialogue.English: That in itself doesn’t really bother me, but…

dialogue.content: １２歳も年下の仕事では先輩の子に
dialogue.English: There's a colleague who is 12 years younger than me, but is my senior at work.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 抜かれているようで、自信喪失しています
dialogue.English: It feels like she has surpassed me, and I'm losing my confidence.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・一回りも年下の先輩というと、気を遣ってしまいますね・・
dialogue.English: I see... It must be awkward having a senior colleague who is 12 years younger than you.

dialogue.content: はい、他の先輩達がその子を認めているのが分かるから・・
dialogue.English: Yes, because I can tell the other senior colleagues recognize her abilities...

dialogue.content: 口に出したり
dialogue.English: They say it out loud,

dialogue.content: 態度に出して
dialogue.English: and they show it in their attitude.

dialogue.content: はい、口に出すというとどんな事を言われれるのですか？
dialogue.English: When you say they say it out loud, what kinds of things do they say?

dialogue.content: その子が居たら安心なのにとか、その子の方が良かった・・とか
dialogue.English: Things like, "It's so reassuring when she's here," or "It would have been better if she were here..."

dialogue.content: その方を頼りにしているという感じなんですね。あなたの前で言われると、比較されているような気がしてくるのですね
dialogue.English: So it sounds like they really rely on her. And when they say that in front of you, it must feel like you're being compared.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。それぞれに長所、短所はあるものの、
dialogue.English: Exactly. We each have our own strengths and weaknesses, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 私だけ役職が無いから、どこかで、要らない存在なんじゃないかと・・
dialogue.English: Because I'm the only one without a title, I feel somewhere inside that maybe I'm not needed.

dialogue.content: そう感じておられるんですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see that's how you're feeling...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 同じように働いているのに自分だけが、と思うと悔しいですよね・・
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating to feel like you're the only one being treated this way, even though you're working just as hard.

dialogue.content: そうですね、周りの先輩たちの言葉や態度に傷ついて・・
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. The words and attitudes of the other senior staff are hurtful...

dialogue.content: しまいます
dialogue.English: they really get to me.

dialogue.content: はい、自分の居場所がないような気持ちになってしまうのですね。。。
dialogue.English: Yes, it makes you feel like you don't have a place there, doesn't it...

dialogue.content: 差し支えなかったらどんな職業か教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind my asking, could you tell me what your profession is?

dialogue.content: はい、そんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's how it feels.

dialogue.content: 介護職員です
dialogue.English: I'm a caregiver.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、新米とおっしゃっていましたが、職場経験は他でおありなのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you're the newest, but do you have work experience elsewhere?

dialogue.content: 私はこの正職員の中で三番目に入社は古いのですが、ずっとパート勤務していたのです。
dialogue.English: Among the full-time staff, I'm actually the third longest-serving employee, but I was working part-time for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。パートから正社員になられたのですね。パートはいつ頃からそこで働いているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you were promoted from part-time to full-time. How long were you working there as a part-timer?

dialogue.content: １５年前です
dialogue.English: For 15 years.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それではパートといえどもとても経験豊富でいらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, even though you were part-time, you must be very experienced.

dialogue.content: はい、主任と看護師よりも現場には詳しいのですが、皆を尊敬しています
dialogue.English: Yes, I know the floor better than the supervisor and the nurse, but I respect everyone.

dialogue.content: １２歳年下の子も尊敬してるけど
dialogue.English: I respect the younger coworker too, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 三年早く入社したという事で、動かない役職が付いていて、
dialogue.English: Because she started three years earlier, she has a permanent title, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 出産の間は私が代わりにしていたのですが
dialogue.English: I covered for her during her maternity leave, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、同じ働きをあなたもできるのですね。
dialogue.English: Right, so you are capable of doing the same work.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 取り返されて、その子が居ないと分からない状態で
dialogue.English: but she took the role back, and now it's like things can't get done without her.

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 色々悔しいってところですね・・
dialogue.English: It's just... frustrating in many ways.

dialogue.content: 私は主に一番しんどい利用者
dialogue.English: I mainly handle the most difficult residents...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: さんの心の中を取り持つ仕事が多いです
dialogue.English: and I do a lot of work mediating and tending to their emotional needs.

dialogue.content: だから、自分の中でおさめるようにしていたけど、
dialogue.English: So I've been trying to just keep it all inside, but...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても重要なお仕事をされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're doing very important work.

dialogue.content: はい（すみません行違ってしまって。続けてくださいね）
dialogue.English: Yes. (Apologies, we seem to have typed at the same time. Please continue.)

dialogue.content: 何か、決めるときに、役職のついた人材から相談したり
dialogue.English: When something needs to be decided, they consult with the staff who have titles first,

dialogue.content: 決めたり報告したりして、
dialogue.English: and they make decisions and reports among themselves,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は利用者さんや職員の伝言役。
dialogue.English: and I'm just a messenger for the residents and staff.

dialogue.content: 仲を取り持つ役割が多いのですが、
dialogue.English: I often play the role of a mediator, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 何か気にいらないのか、あまり仲裁するなみたいに
dialogue.English: I don't know what it is they don't like, but they act as if I shouldn't be mediating so much.

dialogue.content: ええ？
dialogue.English: Oh?

dialogue.content: 態度を取られて、
dialogue.English: They give me that attitude,

dialogue.content: つらいです
dialogue.English: and it's painful.

dialogue.content: それは、納得がいかないですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be hard to accept.

dialogue.content: その態度というのは、その12歳年下の方ですか？
dialogue.English: Is that attitude coming from the coworker who is 12 years younger?

dialogue.content: その態度をとるのは先輩で利用者と関わらない１２歳年下の子を認めている感じ。
dialogue.English: The attitude is from a senior colleague, and it feels like they are doing it to show their approval of the younger colleague, who doesn't interact much with the residents.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・現場の声が一番大事とは認めてもらえない雰囲気なのですね・・それはやていてもやりがいがないと感じてしまいますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... So there's an atmosphere where the voices from the floor aren't recognized as the most important. That must make you feel that your work isn't rewarding.

dialogue.content: とてもやりがいがいない、です。すみません
dialogue.English: "not very rewarding," I mean. My apologies.

dialogue.content: はい、なんだか悔しいです。その先輩も、その１２歳年下の子も、利用者とトラブルがあって
dialogue.English: Yes, it's somehow very frustrating. Both that senior staff member and the younger coworker have had trouble with the residents.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は一切トラブルないし、逆に仲裁して上手く取り持ったりしているから、気に入らないのかな・・とも思いながら
dialogue.English: I never have any trouble—on the contrary, I mediate and smooth things over—so I wonder if that's why they don't like me...

dialogue.content: なんだか馬鹿らしいなって
dialogue.English: It all just feels so ridiculous.

dialogue.content: なるほど。トラブルもないあなたに嫉妬されているのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's possible they're jealous of you for not having any trouble.

dialogue.content: 報告や情報を教えてくれないし、
dialogue.English: They don’t share reports or information with me,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私が皆の輪を保とうとメモ書きで全員に伝言残すと、
dialogue.English: and when I try to keep everyone in the loop by leaving written notes for all,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm,

dialogue.content: ここにメモするなと、私を一切見ずに言ったりします
dialogue.English: they'll say, "Don't leave notes here," without even looking at me.

dialogue.content: そんな態度をとられては、悲しくなってしまいますね。。
dialogue.English: Being treated that way would make anyone feel sad…

dialogue.content: はい、嫉妬かな？と思ったこともありますが、
dialogue.English: Yes, I've wondered if it's jealousy, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 信念を曲げずに頑張っていいのかな・・
dialogue.English: I wonder if it's okay for me to keep trying my best without bending my principles...

dialogue.content: とても周りの皆さんのことを思いやって、気を遣われて、心を砕いてこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: You’ve been so considerate of everyone around you, paying attention to their needs, and pouring your heart into your work.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 嫌われてる先輩とすら
dialogue.English: Even with the senior colleague who dislikes me,

dialogue.content: 上手くやってるけど、それは仕事をスムーズに進めたいからであって
dialogue.English: I try to get along, but that's only because I want the work to go smoothly.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 色々気はつかってます
dialogue.English: I'm very considerate in many ways.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。とてもお気持ち、伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: I understand. Your feelings are coming through very clearly.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 私の感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if I shared my impressions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは、15年続けてきた介護のお仕事で、利用者さんの心をおもんばかって、職場がうまく回るよう立ち回れる、とても気の利く方だと感じました。
dialogue.English: I feel that you are a very thoughtful person who, in your 15 years of caregiving work, has been considerate of the residents' feelings and has managed things to help the workplace run smoothly.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今回、長年のパート勤務から正社員になられ、年下の先輩などから役職がないということもあるのか
dialogue.English: Now that you've become a full-time employee after many years as a part-timer, and perhaps because you don't have a title while having younger senior colleagues,

dialogue.content: 仕事の仕方での嫌な態度をとられても、誠意をもって仕事をつづけていらっしゃいます。とても素晴らしいことです。
dialogue.English: even when you’re treated poorly for how you do your work, you continue to do your job with sincerity. That’s truly admirable.

dialogue.content: それでも、嫌なことを言われたりされたりするのは心がくじけてしまいそうになりますよね。
dialogue.English: Still, being spoken to and treated that way can be very disheartening.

dialogue.content: そのお辛いお気持ちも伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: I can feel how painful that is for you, too.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ここで、今一番つらいこと、許せないと感じることはなんですか？
dialogue.English: At this point, what is the most painful thing for you, or the thing you find hardest to forgive?

dialogue.content: 利用者を見ようとしない、でも仕事の手は早い１２歳年下の子を他の職員が認めている事、それを口に出して聞かせた事
dialogue.English: The fact that other staff members acknowledge my younger coworker—who doesn't try to truly see the residents as people, but is quick with her work—and that they say so out loud for me to hear.

dialogue.content: でしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I suppose that’s it…

dialogue.content: ちあみに
dialogue.English: By the w—

dialogue.content: ちなみに
dialogue.English: By the way,

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: その子の仕事は産休の間、私がしていたし、別に出来るんです
dialogue.English: I did her job while she was on maternity leave, so I'm perfectly capable of doing it.

dialogue.content: 責任者って名前がついているからその子が取り仕切ってるだけ
dialogue.English: She's only in charge because she has the title of "person in charge."

dialogue.content: 悔しいなって
dialogue.English: It's just so frustrating.

dialogue.content: ええ、職場に認めて欲しいですよね。そういう相談などはもっと上の方にしたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand; you want to be recognized by your workplace. Have you ever brought this up with someone higher up?

dialogue.content: そうゆう相談はもっと上には出来ないですね
dialogue.English: No, I can't really talk to someone higher up about that.

dialogue.content: できないというのは、どういったことで？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that you can't?

dialogue.content: 上がその子に責任者って決めたし、ただのやっかみとしか受け取られないでしょう？
dialogue.English: Management was the one who appointed her as the person in charge, so they’d just see it as petty jealousy, right?

dialogue.content: 悔しいから、もっと利用者の近くで笑顔で
dialogue.English: Because I'm frustrated, I try to stay even closer to the residents, with a smile,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 頑張ろうと思うと、段々嫌われるのかも・・とか。
dialogue.English: but then I feel like the harder I try, the more I might be disliked...

dialogue.content: 一つだけ、提案なのですがよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I make one suggestion?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もっと上の方に一度相談されてみることをお勧めしたいのです。
dialogue.English: I would like to recommend that you try talking to someone higher up.

dialogue.content: ・・はい
dialogue.English: ...Okay.

dialogue.content: すぐに役職が与えられるとは考えられないと私も思いますが、職場の現状を相談することで
dialogue.English: I also don't think you'll be given a title right away, but by discussing the current situation at your workplace,

dialogue.content: あなたが信念としている利用者さんにとっての最善を尽くすこと、という信念を曲げる必要があるのか、という点について
dialogue.English: especially regarding the question of whether you need to bend your principle of doing what's best for the residents,

dialogue.content: 何かしらの答えが見えるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I believe you might find some kind of answer.

dialogue.content: いかがですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: はい、少しづつ、やってみます。
dialogue.English: Okay, I’ll try, little by little.

dialogue.content: 上に理解してもらえるかの不安はありますが、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I'm anxious about whether the higher-ups will understand, but thank you.

dialogue.content: 少々強引な提案かもしれませんが・・・タイミングを見計らって、そう、少しづつですね。
dialogue.English: It may be a bit of a forceful suggestion... but watch for the right timing, and yes, do it little by little.

dialogue.content: あなたの真剣な仕事に対する思いは分かってくれる人が必ず現れると思います。
dialogue.English: I believe someone will eventually come along who understands your sincere dedication to your work.

dialogue.content: ほんの微妙な感情のズレや交差のような感じもしますが、やってみます。
dialogue.English: It feels like it might just be a subtle misalignment or crossing of feelings, but I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling after our conversation today?

dialogue.content: 少し楽になりました。
dialogue.English: I feel a little lighter.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 色々な配慮のできるあなたならきっとうまくいくと思います。では、今日は相談を終了してよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since you're someone who is so considerate in so many ways, I'm sure things will work out well. Shall we conclude our session for today?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: では終了ボタンを押させて頂きますね。（長引いていしまいすみませんでした）
dialogue.English: Then I will press the end button now. (I'm sorry this session ran a bit long.)

dialogue.content: いえいえ、こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Not at all, thank you as well.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.
